description: Check the domain a campaign's tracked links point at: whether it resolves, serves a valid certificate, is listed on SURBL, sits on a listed address, belongs under the sending domain, and whether it is a platform's shared tracking host. A listed tracking domain is in the body of every message, which is what content filters hash.

sendingDomain.description: Optional: the domain the mail is sent from, to check the tracker sits under it.

name: check_tracking_domain
title: Click-tracking domain
